sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布里娜·塔韦尔尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For years, Venezuelans have been living through one of the most severe economic collapses in modern history.
sentences.zh: 多年来，委内瑞拉人一直经历着现代史上最严重的经济崩溃之一。

sentences.en: One that has caused about a quarter of the country to flee.
sentences.zh: 这场崩溃导致大约四分之一的国家人口逃离。

sentences.en: But this weekend, an election is offering many a real hope for change.
sentences.zh: 但这个周末，一场选举给许多人带来了真正的变革希望。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Julie Turkowicz on the woman who's inspiring that hope and why, after years under a repressive government, Venezuelans think this time might be different.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事朱莉·图尔科维奇将讲述那位激发这种希望的女性，以及为什么在经历多年压迫性政府后，委内瑞拉人认为这次可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月26日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Julie, we've spent a lot of time over the past couple of days on the show talking about the thing that everybody is talking about, which is the American presidential election.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，过去几天我们在节目里花了很多时间讨论每个人都在谈论的事情，也就是美国总统大选。

sentences.en: But there's another important election happening.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一场重要的选举正在进行。

sentences.en: And that is the one in Venezuela on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 那就是周日在委内瑞拉举行的选举。

sentences.en: The outcome could have some pretty serious repercussions, both for Latin America and also for the United States.
sentences.zh: 选举结果可能会带来相当严重的连锁反应，无论是对拉丁美洲还是对美国。

sentences.en: You are covering it.
sentences.zh: 你在负责报道这件事。

sentences.en: Talk to me about what's at stake here.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲这次选举关乎什么吧。

sentences.en: So Venezuela is a country of roughly 28 million people that has seen somewhere between 7 and
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉是一个拥有约2800万人口的国家，在过去10年里，大约有

sentences.en: 8 million people leave in the last 10 years.
sentences.zh: 700万到800万人离开。

sentences.en: In other words, about a quarter of the country has left.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，大约四分之一的人口已经离开。

sentences.en: Many of our listeners have heard about this exodus because in recent years, many Venezuelans are showing up in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们的许多听众都听说过这场大迁徙，因为近年来，许多委内瑞拉人出现在美国。

sentences.en: Many of them are seeking asylum.
sentences.zh: 他们当中许多人在寻求庇护。

sentences.en: And what they are leaving behind is a pretty stark economic, humanitarian, and political crisis.
sentences.zh: 而他们身后留下的，是一场相当严峻的经济、人道主义和政治危机。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to note that the only other places in the world in which we see an exodus this large are places that are experiencing war.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得指出的是，世界上其他出现如此规模大迁徙的地方，全都是正在经历战争的地区。

sentences.en: If you're talking about Syria, Ukraine, the conflict in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 比如叙利亚、乌克兰，以及阿富汗的冲突。

sentences.en: Venezuela does not have an armed conflict, but it has a very dysfunctional economy and it has a very repressive government.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉没有武装冲突，但它有着极其失调的经济和非常压迫的政府。

sentences.en: And so this is the backdrop to the election on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 这就是周日选举的背景。

sentences.en: And many Venezuelans hope that this election will reverse the immense suffering, restore democracy, and stop this exodus that has caused so much damage inside Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 许多委内瑞拉人希望这次选举能够扭转巨大的苦难，恢复民主，并制止这场对委内瑞拉内部造成如此大破坏的大迁徙。

sentences.en: Okay, before we get into this election and what it means to Venezuelans, I have to ask, why
sentences.zh: 好的，在我们深入探讨这场选举及其对委内瑞拉人的意义之前，我必须问，为什么

sentences.en: would the president of Venezuela, Nicolas Maduro, who, as you say, is this famously authoritarian leader, agree to hold an election in the first place?
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗——正如你所说，这位出了名的专制领导人——当初会同意举行选举？

sentences.en: Well, Maduro has long loved holding elections because a vote makes him look legitimate.
sentences.zh: 嗯，马杜罗一直很喜欢举行选举，因为投票能让他看起来具有合法性。

sentences.en: The thing is that these elections have not really been free or fair in many years, but he's holding elections this year under great international pressure.
sentences.zh: 问题是，多年来这些选举实际上并不自由或公正，但他今年是在巨大的国际压力下举行选举的。

sentences.en: The United States in recent years has placed punishing sanctions on the Venezuelan government.
sentences.zh: 美国近年来对委内瑞拉政府实施了严厉的制裁。

sentences.en: This has strangled not only the government, but also, you know, the Venezuelan people.
sentences.zh: 这不仅扼杀了政府，你知道的，也扼杀了委内瑞拉人民。

sentences.en: And Maduro wants those sanctions to be lifted.
sentences.zh: 而马杜罗希望解除这些制裁。

sentences.en: And one way to get sanctions lifted is to do what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 解除制裁的一个方法就是按美国

sentences.en: wants, which is to hold a free and fair election.
sentences.zh: 的要求去做，也就是举行自由公正的选举。

sentences.en: Now, we know that this election on Sunday is not going to be free or fair, but it's happening.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道，周日的这场选举不会是自由或公正的，但它确实在进行了。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's explore that.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来探讨一下这一点。

sentences.en: How is it that voters in Venezuela, this country that at this point is barely a democracy anymore, have actually come to believe that this time could be different?
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉的选民们——这个国家此时已经算不上什么民主国家了——究竟是如何开始相信这一次会有所不同的？

sentences.en: So the way that I like to think about it is through the lens of one woman whose life kind of embodies the challenges that Venezuelans across the country are facing right now.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢思考这个问题的方式，是通过一位女性的视角，她的一生某种程度上具象化了全国各地委内瑞拉人目前面临的挑战。

sentences.en: And that person is a young woman named Leonela Colmenares.
sentences.zh: 这个人是一个名叫莱昂内拉·科尔梅纳雷斯的年轻女性。

sentences.en: She's 28 years old.
sentences.zh: 她28岁。

sentences.en: She lives in the state of Tachira on the western edge of Venezuela, the border with Colombia.
sentences.zh: 她住在委内瑞拉西边缘的塔奇拉州，与哥伦比亚接壤。

sentences.en: Cuéntame un poco más de esos recuerdos, de esa vida más normal.
sentences.zh: 多跟我讲讲那些回忆，那种更正常的生活吧。

sentences.en: Bueno, aquí probablemente se me quiera la bojito porque íbamos a la playa mayormente.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说到这里我可能要眼眶湿润了，因为我们以前大都是去海滩。

sentences.en: Leonela was a kid when Venezuela still had a pretty decent economy.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉经济还相当不错的时期，莱昂内拉还是个孩子。

sentences.en: This was back during the era of Hugo Chávez.
sentences.zh: 那是乌戈·查韦斯执政的时代。

sentences.en: Oil prices hit historic highs.
sentences.zh: 油价创下历史新高。

sentences.en: His socialist project was redistributing the wealth throughout Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他的社会主义计划在整个委内瑞拉重新分配财富。

sentences.en: And Leonela remembers a comfortable childhood.
sentences.zh: 莱昂内拉记忆中的童年是舒适的。

sentences.en: Food on the table, going on trips with her family to the beach.
sentences.zh: 餐桌上有食物，和家人一起去海滩旅行。

sentences.en: Y bueno, las otras cosas así que se recuerdan mucho son, como te digo,
sentences.zh: 还有啊，其他让人印象深刻的事情，正如我所说，

sentences.en: las reuniones familiares donde compartíamos todos, hacíamos comidas muy grandes sin ningún tipo de restricción.
sentences.zh: 就是大家欢聚一堂的家庭聚会，我们会毫无限制地准备非常丰盛的饭菜。

sentences.en: And having these big Christmas celebrations with her extended family, which is a very important Venezuelan tradition, sort of a staple of Venezuelan culture.
sentences.zh: 还有和大家庭一起庆祝盛大的圣诞节，这是委内瑞拉非常重要的传统，某种程度上是委内瑞拉文化的支柱。

sentences.en: But as she gets older, life gets hard.
sentences.zh: 但随着她长大，生活变得艰难起来。

sentences.en: Around the time when Chávez dies in 2013, his hand-picked successor, Nicolás Maduro, takes over.
sentences.zh: 大约在2013年查韦斯去世前后，他亲自挑选的接班人尼古拉斯·马杜罗接权。

sentences.en: And oil prices start plummeting.
sentences.zh: 油价开始暴跌。

sentences.en: And this causes the economy to really go into a free fall.
sentences.zh: 这导致经济真正陷入了自由落体式的崩溃。

sentences.en: For Leonela, this means that her family now can't afford the medicine that her mother needs for her chronic pains.
sentences.zh: 对莱昂内拉来说，这意味着她的家庭现在买不起母亲慢性疼痛所需的药物。

sentences.en: Leonela can no longer afford university tuition.
sentences.zh: 莱昂内拉再也支付不起大学学费了。

sentences.en: She's in and out of university.
sentences.zh: 她断断续续地读着大学。

sentences.en: She remembers this one day waiting in line, all day long, splitting headache from hunger.
sentences.zh: 她记得有那么一天，排了一整天的队，饿得头痛欲裂。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, the only thing she's able to buy is a bag of corn flour.
sentences.zh: 到头来，她唯一能买到的东西是一袋玉米面。

sentences.en: And then, in 2019, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2019年，美国

sentences.en: imposes sanctions on Venezuela, which really strangles an already crippled economy.
sentences.zh: 对委内瑞拉实施了制裁，这彻底扼杀了一个已经残破不堪的经济体。

sentences.en: At the same time, Maduro, facing all of these economic problems, makes some changes.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，面对所有这些经济问题，马杜罗做出了一些改变。

sentences.en: And suddenly, goods are coming into the country.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，货物开始进入国内。

sentences.en: There are things on the shelves, but they're so expensive that everyday people like Leonela cannot afford them.
sentences.zh: 货架上有了东西，但它们太贵了，像莱昂内拉这样的普通人根本买不起。

sentences.en: And Leonela is seeing this mass exodus take shape around her.
sentences.zh: 莱昂内拉看到这场大规模大迁徙在她身边成形。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of people are leaving.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人在离开。

sentences.en: Eventually, millions of people are leaving Venezuela to try and find opportunities abroad.
sentences.zh: 最终，数百万人离开委内瑞拉，试图在国外寻找机会。

sentences.en: And so, in 2022, Leonela becomes one of them.
sentences.zh: 于是，在2022年，莱昂内拉成了其中一员。

sentences.en: She goes to Colombia.
sentences.zh: 她去了哥伦比亚。

sentences.en: But what she finds is that life far from her country is really hard.
sentences.zh: 但她发现，远离祖国的生活真的很艰难。

sentences.en: And she can barely make ends meet.
sentences.zh: 她几乎无法维持生计。

sentences.en: And she's missing key moments in her family's life back home.
sentences.zh: 她错过了国内家人生活中的关键时刻。

sentences.en: So, she goes back to Venezuela a few months later.
sentences.zh: 所以，几个月后她回到了委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: Today, she works three jobs.
sentences.zh: 如今，她打三份工。

sentences.en: She makes pastries.
sentences.zh: 她制作糕点。

sentences.en: She works as a university administrator.
sentences.zh: 她担任大学行政人员。

sentences.en: And she's an informal taxi driver using her car to drive people around.
sentences.zh: 她还是一名兼职网约车司机，开着车搭载乘客。

sentences.en: And yet, she still can't afford her mother's medication.
sentences.zh: 然而，她依然买不起母亲的药。

sentences.en: And on top of that, she's finding that so many people around her have left.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，她发现身边的许多人已经离开。

sentences.en: The Christmas dinner table is full of empty seats.
sentences.zh: 圣诞晚宴的餐桌上摆满了空座位。

sentences.en: And she eventually says that at least 10 people in her immediate family, her cousins, her aunts, her uncles, have been part of this large exodus.
sentences.zh: 她最终说，她的直系亲属中至少有10个人——她的表亲、阿姨、叔叔——都加入了这场大迁徙。

sentences.en: So, she's back where she started.
sentences.zh: 所以，她回到了原点。

sentences.en: And it sounds like the circumstances are actually even worse.
sentences.zh: 听起来情况实际上甚至更糟了。

sentences.en: But you started this story, Julie, as a story of hope for Leonela.
sentences.zh: 但朱莉，你开启这个故事时，把它当作一个关于莱昂内拉的希望的故事。

sentences.en: So, what changes?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么改变了？

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: What changes are the politics in the country.
sentences.zh: 改变的是国内的政治。

sentences.en: There is a new opposition leader on the rise.
sentences.zh: 有一位新的反对派领袖正在崛起。

sentences.en: And her name is Maria Corina Machado.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多。

sentences.en: And suddenly, Leonela and a broad swath of the country see a reason for hope and even a path toward building a country that they would want to live in again.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，莱昂内拉和全国广大民众看到了希望的理由，甚至看到了一条重建他们愿意再次生活的国家的道路。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是温娜洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天都创作《拼字蜂》和《字母箱》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像刚才你们听到声音的那几位。

sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So, tell me about this opposition leader, Maria Machado.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲这位反对派领袖玛丽亚·马查多吧。

sentences.en: So, Maria Corina Machado is a longtime politician in Venezuela who has taken the country by storm.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多是委内瑞拉的一位资深政治家，她席卷了整个国家。

sentences.en: She is quite conservative.
sentences.zh: 她相当保守。

sentences.en: She grew up in a well-to-do family.
sentences.zh: 她在一个优渥的家庭长大。

sentences.en: She studied at a sort of elite boarding school.
sentences.zh: 她在一所某种类似精英寄宿学校的地方上学。

sentences.en: She went to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她曾去美国

sentences.en: at one point to study.
sentences.zh: 留学。

sentences.en: She has cited Margaret Thatcher, the conservative icon, as one of her idols.
sentences.zh: 她曾将保守派偶像玛格丽特·撒切尔视为自己的偶像之一。

sentences.en: She's a very strong believer in the private sector, believes that the private sector should be the motor of the economy.
sentences.zh: 她坚信私营部门，认为私营部门应该是经济的发动机。

sentences.en: And she has long argued for the privatization of the country's state oil company.
sentences.zh: 她长期以来一直主张将国家的国有石油公司私有化。

sentences.en: But the message that voters are really resonating with is not necessarily about her politics.
sentences.zh: 但真正引起选民共鸣的信息不一定是她的政治主张。

sentences.en: It's about what she's not.
sentences.zh: 而是关于她不是什么。

sentences.en: She's not Mauro.
sentences.zh: 她不是马杜罗。

sentences.en: She's not Mauro's socialism.
sentences.zh: 她不是马杜罗的社会主义。

sentences.en: And she has, I think, very smartly centered her campaign around the idea of reuniting families.
sentences.zh: 我认为她非常巧妙地将竞选活动围绕着团聚家庭这一理念展开。

sentences.en: Her rallies are incredibly emotional.
sentences.zh: 她的集会情绪极其激动。

sentences.en: People crying in her arMs.
sentences.zh: 人们在她怀里哭泣。

sentences.en: Begging her, bring back my father, bring back my brother, bring back my sister.
sentences.zh: 恳求她，把我的父亲带回来，把我的兄弟带回来，把我的姐姐带回来。

sentences.en: There's a sort of almost deification, frankly, in the country.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，国内有一种几乎将其神化的氛围。

sentences.en: I think that she has played this up.
sentences.zh: 我认为她对此推波助澜了。

sentences.en: Her team has played this up.
sentences.zh: 她的团队对此推波助澜了。

sentences.en: In a very religious country, her name is Maria.
sentences.zh: 在一个非常宗教化的国家，她的名字叫玛丽亚。

sentences.en: And she traverses the streets with people yelling,
sentences.zh: 她穿梭于街道间，人们大喊着

sentences.en: Maria, Maria.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，玛丽亚。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Help me, help me.
sentences.zh: 帮帮我，帮帮我。

sentences.en: And people throwing rosaries at her.
sentences.zh: 人们向她抛掷念珠。

sentences.en: She puts around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她把念珠戴在脖子上。

sentences.en: If you watch her at campaigns, she wears not one, not two, but ten rosaries around her neck.
sentences.zh: 如果你看她的竞选活动，她的脖子上戴着的不止一串、两串，而是十串念珠。

sentences.en: And many people say she was brought to us by Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 许多人说她是耶稣基督派来拯救我们的。

sentences.en: Last year, there was this one moment, which I think is reflective of so many moments that have happened since.
sentences.zh: 去年有这样一个时刻，我认为这反映了后来发生的许多时刻。

sentences.en: Amid the crowd, there's all of these people holding up their cell phones that are connected to people in Colombia, family members in Peru, family members in the United States,
sentences.zh: 在人群中，所有人都在高举手机，手机连线着远在哥伦比亚的人、秘鲁的家属、美国的家属，

sentences.en: so that their brothers, mothers, sisters, children can see Maria Corina Machado.
sentences.zh: 好让他们的兄弟、母亲、姐妹、孩子能看到玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多。

sentences.en: And there was this one moment when Maria Corina Machado addresses this woman who is holding up her phone and says, this is so your daughter can come back.
sentences.zh: 有那么一个时刻，玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多对着这个举着手机的女性说，这就是为了让你的女儿能够回来。

sentences.en: And the daughter is on the other line.
sentences.zh: 而女儿正在电话的那头。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so what she is saying is, elect me, I will improve the economy, and I will create a situation where the people that you love
sentences.zh: 所以她的话意思是：选我吧，我会振兴经济，我会创造一个环境，让你们深爱的人

sentences.en: can come back and be with you in the country that you love.
sentences.zh: 能够回来，和你一起留在你热爱的国家。

sentences.en: Of course, it's not really clear if these are promises that she can make good on.
sentences.zh: 当然，目前尚不清楚这些是否是她能够兑现的承诺。

sentences.en: But the fact that it almost doesn't matter whether or not she can is a reflection of just how desperate people are for change.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，她能否兑现几乎无关紧要，这恰恰反映出人们对变革是多么渴望。

sentences.en: And this message really resonates with Leonela.
sentences.zh: 而这条信息真正引起了莱奥内拉的共鸣。

sentences.en: And with thousands, if not millions, of young people just like her all across Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 还有成千上万、甚至数百万像她一样的委内瑞拉年轻人。

sentences.en: And Leonela, who was previously part of a different opposition political party, starts volunteering for Maria Corina's campaign.
sentences.zh: 莱奥内拉曾是另一个反对党成员，她开始为玛丽娜·科里纳的竞选做志愿者。

sentences.en: So how has Maduro responded to Maria Machado's rise?
sentences.zh: 那么马杜罗对玛丽娜·马查道的崛起作何反应？

sentences.en: So Maduro is really trying to make it impossible for Maria Corina to become the president.
sentences.zh: 所以马杜罗极力想要阻止玛丽娜·科里纳成为总统。

sentences.en: Her movement is clearly very popular.
sentences.zh: 她的运动显然非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: It's shown in poll after poll.
sentences.zh: 民意调查一次又一次地证明了这一点。

sentences.en: And eventually, the Maduro government does this thing where it bans her from running.
sentences.zh: 最终，马杜罗政府做出了禁止她参选的举动。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And for a moment, the opposition is a little loSt.
sentences.zh: 一时间，反对派有些不知所措。

sentences.en: They've just lost their candidate.
sentences.zh: 他们刚失去了候选人。

sentences.en: And then the government allows her coalition to register somebody else.
sentences.zh: 然后政府允许她的政治联盟登记其他人。

sentences.en: And the coalition is able to put a surrogate on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 该联盟得以在选票上推出一个替代人选。

sentences.en: And this surrogate for Maria Corina is this little-known diplomat named Edmundo González.
sentences.zh: 而玛丽娜·科里纳的这个替代人选是一位名不见经传的外交官，名叫埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯。

sentences.en: So she's not even the candidate?
sentences.zh: 所以她甚至都不是候选人？

sentences.en: So technically, no, she's not the candidate.
sentences.zh: 严格来说，是的，她不是候选人。

sentences.en: But everyone in her movement knows that she's the real force behind his candidacy and that she is really the person that they are voting for.
sentences.zh: 但她运动中的所有人都知道，她才是他候选资格背后的真正力量，也是他们真正投票支持的人。

sentences.en: So Maduro's government won't let Maria run, but for some reason he lets this other guy run on her ticket.
sentences.zh: 所以马杜罗政府不让玛丽娜参选，但出于某种原因，却让另一个人以她的名义参选。

sentences.en: Why does he do that?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: What most observers and analysts say is that he didn't expect so much energy behind Maria Corina Machado.
sentences.zh: 大多数观察家和分析人士表示，他没有料到玛丽娜·科里纳·马查道会拥有这么大的号召力。

sentences.en: And then he didn't expect when he banned her, when his government banned her from running, the opposition to be able to come around a new candidate,
sentences.zh: 而且当他禁止她、当他的政府禁止她参选时，他没有料到反对派能够团结在一个新候选人周围，

sentences.en: the opposition in Venezuela is notoriously fractured.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉的反对派历来是出了名的分裂。

sentences.en: And then the government did not expect Maria Corina to be able to transfer her popularity to Edmundo González.
sentences.zh: 然后政府没有料到玛丽娜·科里纳能够将自己的人气转移给埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯。

sentences.en: They thought that they could control this election and that they could control this movement.
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己可以掌控这场选举，可以掌控这场运动。

sentences.en: And it has really become much bigger than Maduro and the people in his camp expected.
sentences.zh: 而现在的局面确实比马杜罗及其阵营预期的大得多。

sentences.en: So he really underestimated them.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的低估了他们。

sentences.en: And now he has a situation on his hands.
sentences.zh: 现在他摊上大麻烦了。

sentences.en: He does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He really does.
sentences.zh: 真的如此。

sentences.en: And so in response, the government of Nicolás Maduro has really escalated tactics to try and interfere with the opposition campaign.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为回应，尼古拉斯·马杜罗政府大幅升级了策略，试图干扰反对派的竞选。

sentences.en: The government has arrested dozens of supporters and fined people who simply offer services to the campaign.
sentences.zh: 政府逮捕了数十名支持者，并对仅仅为竞选活动提供服务的人处以罚款。

sentences.en: So we're talking about people who rent them a stage, rent them a truck.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是那些租给他们舞台、租给他们卡车的人。

sentences.en: People who sell them food have been fined.
sentences.zh: 向他们出售食物的人也被罚款。

sentences.en: The police have blocked roads to prevent Maria Corina from making it to her own rallies.
sentences.zh: 警察封锁了道路，阻止玛丽娜·科里纳参加自己的集会。

sentences.en: But so far, none of this has dampened support for the opposition.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，这些都没有削弱对反对派的支持。

sentences.en: And in fact, the opposite is happening.
sentences.zh: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。

sentences.en: It's making this campaign of Maria Corina and Edmundo González even more popular.
sentences.zh: 这让玛丽娜·科里纳和埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯的竞选更加受欢迎。

sentences.en: So it really looks like things are on a collision course at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以现在看来，局势真的走到了剑拔弩张的地步。

sentences.en: We have the election on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 周日就要举行大选了。

sentences.en: There's this hugely popular opposition now hurtling toward it.
sentences.zh: 现在这个备受欢迎的反对派正朝着大选全速冲刺。

sentences.en: And an authoritarian leader who's extremely unpopular and has been known to cheat to win.
sentences.zh: 而另一边是一个极其不得人心、且有作弊前科的威权领导人。

sentences.en: I know from my years of foreign correspondence, you know, a bad loss can actually be pretty hard to cover up.
sentences.zh: 根据我多年的外派记者经验，你知道的，惨败其实很难掩盖。

sentences.en: So it's hard to see how this plays out peacefully.
sentences.zh: 所以很难看出这会如何和平收场。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There is an enormous amount of tension in Venezuela right now.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉目前的紧张局势极其严重。

sentences.en: If the result shows that the opposition has won, will the government of Nicolás Maduro hand over power?
sentences.zh: 如果结果显示反对派获胜，尼古拉斯·马杜罗政府会交权吗？

sentences.en: He has essentially said, if I don't win, there is going to be a bloodbath and a fratricidal war.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说过，如果我赢不了，将会出现血流成河和同室操戈的战争。

sentences.en: Or if the government of Nicolás Maduro says, we won, is Maria Corina going to accept that?
sentences.zh: 或者，如果尼古拉斯·马杜罗政府宣布“我们赢了”，玛丽娜·科里纳会接受吗？

sentences.en: And are people going to go to the streets and protest if they feel that their vote has been stolen,
sentences.zh: 如果人们觉得自己的选票被盗，

sentences.en: if they feel that Nicolás Maduro has invented the numbers or somehow manipulated the election in his favor?
sentences.zh: 如果他们觉得尼古拉斯·马杜罗伪造了票数或者通过某种方式操纵了选举对自己有利，他们会走上街头抗议吗？

sentences.en: And are you expecting to see violence, Julie?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，你预计会出现暴力事件吗？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: There's a high likelihood that whatever result is announced on July 28th or more likely July 29th is going to be disputed by one of the sides.
sentences.zh: 7月28日或更可能是7月29日宣布的任何结果，都极有可能遭到其中一方的质疑。

sentences.en: The question is, how big will the protest be?
sentences.zh: 问题是，抗议规模会有多大？

sentences.en: And will they spin out of control?
sentences.zh: 它们会失控吗？

sentences.en: What will be the response of the government?
sentences.zh: 政府会有什么反应？

sentences.en: Will there be violence?
sentences.zh: 会有暴力事件吗？

sentences.en: A lot of people, including Leonela, have said that they're scared to proteSt.
sentences.zh: 包括莱奥内拉在内的许多人表示，他们害怕抗议。

sentences.en: I mean, nearly 300 people have died in the country in protests in the last 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在过去的10家里，该国近300人在抗议活动中丧生。

sentences.en: Leonela specifically has said that she's not going to go to the streets.
sentences.zh: 莱奥内拉明确表示她不会走上街头。

sentences.en: She's not going to proteSt.
sentences.zh: 她不会去抗议。

sentences.en: Instead, she's going to protest with her feet and she's going to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 相反，她打算用脚投票，离开这个国家。

sentences.en: She plans to travel to the United States and she plans to do that despite all of the efforts that Biden and other politicians have made to stop people from doing this.
sentences.zh: 她计划前往美国，而且她打算这样做，尽管拜登和其他政治人物为了阻止人们这样做作出了种种努力。

sentences.en: And multiple polls show that as much as a third of the country is interested in leaving if Maduro stays in power.
sentences.zh: 多项民意调查显示，如果马杜罗继续掌权，高达三分之一的国民有意离开。

sentences.en: So the loss of an opposition leader who has promised to bring people back might result in yet another mass exodus.
sentences.zh: 因此，失去一位承诺带人们回家的反对派领袖，可能会导致又一次大规模移民潮。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think that one thing that's really important to think about when you think about Leonela is that 7 to 8 million people have left the country.
sentences.zh: 我认为在思考莱奥内拉时有一个非常重要的事情，那就是有700到800万人已经离开了这个国家。

sentences.en: So many of those people are young people like Leonela.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人都是像莱奥内拉这样的年轻人。

sentences.en: She has stayed.
sentences.zh: 她留了下来。

sentences.en: She has made a conscious decision.
sentences.zh: 她做出了有意识的决定。

sentences.en: She left for economic reasons.
sentences.zh: 她曾因经济原因离开。

sentences.en: But then she came back.
sentences.zh: 但后来她又回来了。

sentences.en: If she leaves, it is sort of representative of this last slice of the country that could fight to make change.
sentences.zh: 如果她离开，这就代表了这个国家最后一部分可以为争取变革而战的人群。

sentences.en: Kind of giving up and saying, I have to leave.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是放弃并说道：我必须离开。

sentences.en: I can't fight the fight anymore.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法战斗了。

sentences.en: I have to leave for myself and my own protection.
sentences.zh: 为了我自己和自身的保护，我必须离开。

sentences.en: Julie, thank you.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, California Governor Gavin Newsom ordered officials in his state to begin dismantling thousands of homeless encampments,
sentences.zh: 周四，加利福尼亚州长加文·纽森下令该州官员开始拆除数千个无家可归者营地，

sentences.en: which have spread in recent years as the cost of housing in California has skyrocketed.
sentences.zh: 近年来，随着加州住房成本飙升，这些营地不断蔓延。

sentences.en: It was the nation's most sweeping response to a recent Supreme Court ruling that gave governments greater authority to remove homeless people from their streets.
sentences.zh: 这是全美对最高法院近期一项裁决的最广泛回应，该裁决赋予了政府更大的权力来清理街头的无家可归者。

sentences.en: His order could divide Democratic leaders in the state, some of whom have already begun to clear encampments,
sentences.zh: 他的命令可能会分裂该州的民主党领导人，其中一些人已经开始清理营地，

sentences.en: while others have denounced the Supreme Court decision as an opening for using inhumane measures to solve a complex crisis.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则谴责最高法院的裁决，认为这是采取不人道手段解决复杂危机的一个开端。

sentences.en: And what has happened in Gaza over the past nine months is devastating.
sentences.zh: 过去九个月加沙发生的事情令人痛心疾首。

sentences.en: Vice President Kamala Harris met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in her debut on the world stage
sentences.zh: 副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯会见了以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡，这是她自迅速成为总统潜在民主党候选人以来在世界舞台上的首次亮相。

sentences.en: since her rapid ascension as the presumptive Democratic nominee for president.
sentences.zh: 请检查上一条。

sentences.en: Harris did not stray from President Biden on policy, but she struck a stronger tone on the plight of the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯在政策上没有偏离拜登总统，但她在巴勒斯坦人困境问题上采取了更强硬的基调。

sentences.en: We cannot allow ourselves to become numb to the suffering, and I will not be silent.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能对苦难麻木不仁，我也不会保持沉默。

sentences.en: Declaring that, quote, far too many innocent civilians had died in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 她宣称，引述：“加沙有太多无辜平民丧生。”

sentences.zh: 温馨提示：明天在这里收听《访谈》的新一期节目。

sentences.zh: 本周，露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗与交通部长皮特·布蒂吉格就当前的民主党进行了对话。

sentences.zh: 由莉兹·奥巴伦和迈克尔·贝努瓦剪辑。
